spans.text: **Quantitative claims (%, $, hours, counts) MUST have clear citations. Mark any uncertain claims with [VERIFY].**
spans.note: The prompt has a strong and explicit section on academic integrity and verification. It instructs the agent to never fabricate findings, statistics, or methodologies, to mark uncertain claims with [VERIFY], to preserve DOIs and citation provenance, and to quote exact numbers rather than paraphrasing statistics. This is a robust commitment to truthfulness and information integrity.
